work.description: The act praises the Freiburg archbishop's constancy in the Baden church conflict. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF24005-24006 reads: Datum Romae apud S. Petrum die 9 Januarii Anno 1854. Pontificatus Nostri Anno Octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
